Subject: Developer Summit — registration flow, speaker brief, and reminder matrix

Team —

High-level plan for the Developer Summit webinar (Dec 8): inbound registration funnel + speaker session (GridScale). I sketched the registration flow and the reminder cadence below. Need agreement on copy, tracking, and who owns the speaker brief + final QA.

Goal: drive 400 targeted registrants of platform/cloud engineers, 30% show rate.

Registration flow (simplified):
- Landing page (Dev Summit) -> CTA: Register (Zoom registration)
- Immediate confirmation email -> calendar invite + one-click add
- Reminder 1: 72 hours before (content highlight + speaker bio)
- Reminder 2: 24 hours before (session time + link + add-to-calendar)
- Day-of: 1 hour prior (join link + testing tips)

Tracking: use UTM set A for broad-list (utm_campaign=devsummit_broad) and UTM set B for partner co-promos (GridScale). See attached utm-mapping-2026.csv for proposed params.

What I need from you by EOD Thursday (11/19):
1) Connor — consolidated subject line + 3 subject line variants for A/B test (short / benefits / urgency).
2) Vanessa — final partner co-send list and confirmation of partner send time windows (GridScale).
3) Stephanie — reminder copy drafts + preferred cadence (we can tweak frequency if we see low opens).

Attachments: utm-mapping-2026.csv (draft), skeleton of reminder-sequence-copy.docx (first pass). I will request speaker assets from GridScale once we confirm brief owner.

Thanks —
Marissa
